description.zh: 靠近玩家遗体时，它可能起身成为携带剩余遗物的近战僵尸。
description.en: Player corpses may rise as melee revenants carrying their remaining belongings.

disable.zh: 停用前先捡走僵尸尸体上的东西，再保存。停用后读档，死僵尸的遗物需要重新启用本包才能搜取。
disable.en: Loot dead revenants and save before disabling. After loading without this mod, re-enable it to loot their bodies.

uninstall.zh: 卸载前先捡走僵尸尸体上的东西，再保存。卸载后读档，死僵尸的遗物需要重新安装本包才能搜取。
uninstall.en: Loot dead revenants and save before uninstalling. After loading without this mod, reinstall it to loot their bodies.
